NOTE: Al Jazeera (20 Jul). Russian strike on grain ship (Golden Leo, Guinea-Bissau-flagged, Turkish-owned, corn cargo, crew Syria+India + Ukrainian pilot) near Odesa killed at least 10 (Sun 19 Jul), 8 rescued. Ukraine launched 400+ drones at Moscow region overnight (Sobyanin: between 8:30pm and 5am; 85 destroyed approaching capital), wounding at least 10 incl a child and 3 Chinese citizens (Vorobyov). Zelensky: struck oil depot + logistics facilities 400km+ from border. Consequences in Podolsk, Domodedovo, Odintsovo. Follows Sat Ukrainian drone attacks killing Wildberries warehouse workers.
